title: Approval of a ten (10)-year Non-Exclusive Luggage Cart Concession Agreement with Smarte Carte Inc.: With three (3) one-year extension options, covering luggage cart services at Los Angeles Internation
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a ten (10)-year Non-Exclusive Luggage Cart Concession Agreement with Smarte Carte Inc.: With three (3) one-year extension options, covering luggage cart services at Los Angeles International Airport, for estimated revenue of $2,500,000 over the initial term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Approves a 10-year non-exclusive luggage cart concession with Smarte Carte at LAX, with three one-year extension options and about $2.5 million in estimated revenue over the initial term.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
